root.label: Clean Label Project 2026 cat food contaminant study

events.label: Clean Label Project 2026 cat food contaminant study

slots.name: cadmium detection
slots.sentence: Cadmium was detected in 96% of the products, while arsenic was found in 94%, according to the organization's 2026 Cat Food Category Report released on Oct. 2.

slots.name: mercury ratio
slots.sentence: Most brands contributed only one product, limiting what the study can show about individual brands.

slots.name: wet mercury ratio
slots.sentence: Fish or seafood-containing products had about 18 times more mercury than other cat foods after accounting for whether they were wet or dry, according to the report.

slots.name: high mercury share
slots.sentence: Among wet foods, fish-based products had about 28 times more mercury than wet foods made with other proteins.

slots.name: poultry high mercury
slots.sentence: Nearly half (48.6%) of fish and seafood products ranked among those with the highest mercury levels.

slots.name: fish cadmium ratio
slots.sentence: Fish-based cat foods also had about 2.5 times more cadmium than other products.

slots.name: dry food lead ratio
slots.sentence: Dry cat food had roughly three times more lead than wet or air-dried food after accounting for calories.

slots.name: glyphosate detection
slots.sentence: The study found glyphosate, a widely used weed killer, in 37% of the products.

slots.name: AMPA detection
slots.sentence: Its breakdown product, AMPA, was detected in 12%.

slots.name: glyphosate increase
slots.sentence: Each additional plant ingredient in that group was associated with about a 40% increase in glyphosate levels.

slots.name: DEHP detection
slots.sentence: DEHP, a chemical used in some plastics, was detected in 48 of the 100 products.

slots.name: DEHP packaging ratio
slots.sentence: Among products where it was found, canned and pouched foods had about five times more DEHP than bagged products.

slots.name: BPA products
slots.sentence: BPA was detected in two products and BPS in one.

slots.name: acrylamide products
slots.sentence: Acrylamide, which can form during high-temperature cooking, was measurable in four products and found at very low levels in another 24.

slots.name: lead detection
slots.sentence: A new study found heavy metals in nearly all cat food products tested, including lead, which was detected in 99% of them, according to the nonprofit Clean Label Project.

slots.name: tested products
slots.sentence: Clean Label Project tested 100 cat food products from 62 brands for more than 122 environmental and industrial contaminants and toxins.
